tapToSwap: Tepi imwe kuti uchinje nyika yako kana kugadzirisa ruzivo
releaseTrain26Body: Uri pagame version %s . Tichiri kuvandudza 26.x muPocketCraft — chinja kuenda ku1.21.x kuti uwane zvirinani.
viewDistanceHint: Yakaderera tsika inokurudzirwa kune yakaderera-magumo zvishandiso
maxPowerModeDesc: Inoshandisa RAM yakazara uye max kupa chinhambwe. Inogona kukonzera overheating.
mobSpawningDesc: Inoderedza nhamba yenhengo kuti iite zvirinani
forceExternalJvmDesc: Shandisa yekunze JVM pane iyo yakaunganidzwa
openFolderDesc: Bhurawuza mafaera esevha mune yako faira maneja
managePluginsDesc: Manage ma plugins akaiswa uye zviwanikwa mapakeji
useAddButton: Shandisa bhatani reKuwedzera kuunza faira, kana kuisa imwe kubva kuchiratidziro.
deleteConfirmDesc: Izvi zvinobvisa faira kubva kune yazvino server vhezheni.
pluginsTip: Isa Bukkit/Spigot/Pepa rinoenderana .jar plugins. Tsvaga mapulagi pa spigotmc.org kana hangar.papermc.io
noInternetConnection: Hapana internet yekubatanidza. Ndokumbira utarise network yako.
hubModLoaderDesc: Iyi sevha vhezheni haisi kushandisa inotsigirwa mod loader. Chinja sevha iyi kuita Fabric kana Quilt kuti uise mods.
hubSectionDownloadedDesc: Tonga izvo zvakatochengeterwa iyi server vhezheni.
hubSectionDiscoverDesc: Mibairo yepamhepo chete ndiyo inoratidzwa pano. Mamechi akaiswa akamirirwa iwe.
hubDeleteDesc: Izvi zvichabvisa zvachose faira kubva pane iyi server vhezheni.
hubSearchRetry: Tsvagiridzo dzakachengetwa uye chiyero-chinogumira, saka kuedzazve nechinguvana kazhinji kunoshanda.
hubDetailApplyDesc: Tangazve sevha mushure mekuchinja plugins kana mapaketi.
worldsSlotHint: Sraivha kuruboshwe kuti udzime. Nyika dzinoshanda dzinogona kubviswa chete kana sevha yamiswa.
worldsImportGuideDesc: Tinya kuti uone mashandiro epasirese uye mativi ekunze anoshanda.
worldsResetDesc: Sarudza zvekudzima. Plugins, mods, config files, uye server.properties zvichachengetwa.
worldsResetPreserved: Inogara yakachengetedzwa: plugins/, mods/, config/, server.properties, uye config mafaira.
worldsRestoreDesc:
Izvi zvichadzoreredza: 
 - Nyika nedhimension data 
 - Plugins, mods, uye resource packs 
 - Server configs nesettings 
 
 Mafaira ako epasevha aripo achadzimwa. 
 Ita shuwa kuti sevha yamira usati wadzorera.
worldsDeleteWorldActive: Delete %s ? PocketCraft ichatanga kuenda kune imwe nyika yakachengetwa.
worldsDeleteWorldInactive: Delete %s ? Izvi zvinobvisa nyika kubva mudura.
worldsImportGuideText1: Aternos inotengeswa kunze kwenyika inogona kurodha semaZIP matatu akasiyana: Overworld, Nether, uye The End.
worldsImportGuideText2: Mazhinji mamwe mabhapu epasirese atosanganisira zviyero zvese mune imwe dura, saka imwe chete yepasirese backup yekunze inokwana.
filesAddAnotherWorld: Wedzera imwe nyika usati wadzima iyi.
filesSeedDialogDesc: Pinda mhodzi yenyika yako. Isiye isina chinhu kune nyika isingaite.
filesDeleteWorldDesc: Izvi zvichabvisa zvachose %s uye kuchinjira kune imwe nyika yakachengetwa kana iripo.
onboardingWelcomeTitle:
Foni yako yava 
 sevha yegame server
onboardingWelcomeSubtitle:
Host Java Edition maseva emahara. 
 Hapana PC inodiwa. Tamba nemunhu wese.
onboardingStep1Body: Pepa rinomhanya munharaunda pafoni yako uye rinoshandisa ndangariro yauinayo kare.
onboardingStep2Body: PocketCraft inokupa imwe kero yekudzosera iyo shamwari dzinogona kubatana nayo.
onboardingStep3Body: Vatambi veJava Edition vanobatana zvakananga kuburikidza nerelay nekukwesha kudiki.
onboardingImportSubtitle: Huya nenyika yako, plugins, uye gadzirisa newe. Hapana kutanga patsva.
onboardingImportWorldBody: Tumira kunze kubva kuAternos, donhedza dura muPocketCraft, uye ramba uchienda.
onboardingImportPluginsBody: Shandisa zvakare zvakafanana .jar mafaira. Yako plugin stack inofamba newe.
onboardingImportConfigBody: server.properties, whitelist, uye mushandisi kuwana zvinoramba zvakadaro.
onboardingFeaturesSubtitle: Kwete yakabviswa-pasi app. Iyi ndiyo chaiyo server toolkit.
onboardingCrossPlaySubtitle: PocketCraft inotsigira Java neBedrock cross-play kana zambuko rabatidzwa mukuseta sevha yako.
onboardingCrossPlayJavaBedrockBody: Shamwari paPC uye nharembozha dzinogona kujoinha nyika imwechete pamwe chete kuburikidza nerelay.
onboardingCrossPlayNoExtraAppBody: Govera sevha yako kero uye vatambi vanogona kubatana kubva yavo edition ipapo ipapo.
onboardingCrossPlayExperimental:
⚠️ Chimiro Chekuedza - Tamba paKuzvionera Kwako 
 
 Kutamba-tamba kuchiri kuitika. Bugs uye kugadzikana nyaya zvinogona kuitika sezvo chimiro ichi hachisati chatsigirwa zviri pamutemo. Shandisa panjodzi yako.
onboardingRegionSubtitle: Sarudza iyo relay server iri padyo nevatambi vako. Unogona kushandura izvi gare gare kubva padashboard zvakare.
onboardingPermissionsSubtitle: Izvi zvinoshandiswa sevhavha mamiriro, nhamba yevatambi, uye yakakosha yekumashure zvigadziriso seva yako iri kushanda.
onboardingPermissionsCardBody: Inoratidza sevhisi mamiriro uye kuverenga kwevatambi seva iri kushanda.
onboardingPermissionsStatusSet: Mese makagadzirira. Tinya Next kuti uenderere mberi.
onboardingPermissionsStatusWarn: Kuwanikwa kwekuzivisa kunodiwa padanho iri. Tinya bhatani riri pamusoro, wobva wabvumira mu Android.
onboardingPermissionsStatusTap: Tinya bhatani riri pamusoro, wobva wagamuchira iyo Android mvumo yekumisikidza kuvhura Inotevera.
onboardingPermissionsError: Bvumira mvumo yekuzivisa kuti uenderere mberi.
onboardingGoogleSubtitle: Pinda izvozvi kuti ugone kugonesa zvakavanzika zveGoogle Drive. Unogona kusvetuka izvi wopedza kuseta kutanga.
onboardingGoogleStatusDesc: Backups inochengetwa mukati meyako yakavanzika Google Drive app folda. PocketCraft haikwanise kuona kana kuwana mamwe mafaera eDrive.
onboardingGoogleConnectedDesc: Sevha yako yenyika, maplugins, uye marongero anozozvigadzika otomatiki ku: %s
onboardingSetupBackupNotice: Unogona kudzoreredza nyika backups gare gare muZvirongwa pese paunenge wagadzirira.
